messages:
sophia chen: Heads-up — onboarding calypso-v2 (q5) into staging. Quick smoke shows zh-CN outputs losing spaces around emoji when ZWJ present, causing BLEU to drop ~1.8 on our translation eval set. Repro below. :eyes:

kevin ong: sample? paste the input and model config

sophia chen: input below (note the U+200D between han + emoji):
```
我今天去了公园‍😊，天气很好。
```
staging inference cmd: `redwood infer --model calypso-v2 --quant q5 --seq 512 --input-file sample.txt`

liam rao: curious — is this detok or tokenizer mismatch? Does raw tokenization differ between fp16 and q5?

sophia chen: good q. Tokenizer tokens (token ids) diverge after the ZWJ. fp16 vs q5 tokenization dump:
```
fp16 tokens: [3201, 12834, 99, 50012, 234]
q5 tokens:  [3201, 12834, 99, 234]
```
so q5 dropped the emoji subtoken and effectively merged the preceding char.

eval-bot: automated eval report: model=calypso-v2|quant=q5|dataset=cn-translate-smoke|bleu=27.2|baseline=29.0|delta=-1.8

kevin ong: maybe quant kernel prunes rare utf subtokens. Can you repro with int8/q8x2?

sophia chen: int8 -> tokens match fp16, BLEU delta -0.1. So seems quantization mapping for q5 is the culprit.

liam rao: assign to eng-ml. @kevin can you run kernel tracing on q5 to see where subtoken map changes? add ktrace for tokenization pipeline and kernel selection logs.

kevin ong: will run now. small update: initial kernel trace shows fallback to compact-merge path in q5 at layer 0: `compact_merge_utf_subtoken`.

sophia chen: added full sample + seed for reproducibility: `seed=2024-07-15-zz`

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: calypso-v2-q5-fix-test -> staging at 12:30 PDT

liam rao: suggestion — temporarily map ZWJ to visible marker in preprocessing (u200d-><ZWJ>) to avoid subtoken collapse while kernel fix lands.

sophia chen: tried that hack; BLEU restores to 28.9 and tokens stable. Will add to canary patch.

kevin ong: found suspect line in q5 kernel: `merge_adjacent_small_vocab()` treating single-subtoken emojis as negligible, leading to drop when adjacent to ZWJ. Opening PR.

sophia chen: thanks. Adding eval cases for zh emoji and Arabic RTL with ZWJ in presubmit suite. Also adding a short fuzz set with mixed-script ZWJ placements.

liam rao: nice. once PR lands, run full cn-translate bench and a handful of rtl tests (ar, fa) to ensure no regressions.

sophia chen: noted. I'll run the extended eval after PR merge. :thumbsup:

kevin ong: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/pull/1289 — kernel patch + unit tests

eval-bot: presubmit results: calypso-v2-q5-pr1289 | unit=pass | smoke-bleu=28.8 | regression=ok

sophia chen: merging and kicking the canary. will update thread when full bench completes.

deploy-bot: Canary completed; no infra errors. Promoting to staging.

sophia chen: final bench: BLEU 28.9 (delta -0.1 vs baseline), token parity restored. Closing.

liam rao: great follow-through. :clap:
